explanation.what: All three readers this change adds take the last count entries with slice(-count), and each returns every entry for a count of 0: one shape, three instances.
explanation.why: This change wrote the three readers and declares 0 a count they accept, the one that hides the section.
explanation.fix: Return an empty list when count is 0, or take log.entries.slice(Math.max(0, length - count)), in all three readers.

arguments.failureScenario: recentErrors(log, 0) evaluates slice(-0), which is slice(0), and returns every error in the log rather than none, so a viewer who set the section to 0 to hide it sees the whole error history. recentWarnings(log, 0) and recentMessages(log, 0) do the same at lines 10 and 14: three readers, one shape.
